The search is complete. I now have a full picture of the outbound delivery execution and its internal network protections.

The webhook dispatchers live in `memo_service_webhooks.go` and `memo_update_helpers.go`. They enqueue payloads via `webhook.PostAsync` rather than executing HTTP directly. The actual outbound delivery runs elsewhere.

`PostAsync` in `internal/webhook/webhook.go` queues payloads to an `asyncPostQueue` channel. Four worker goroutines consume that channel and call `Post` to perform the actual HTTP request. The outbound delivery itself lives in the `Post` function at line 152, which uses `safeClient.Do(req)`. The protection mechanism is `ValidateURL` in `internal/webhook/validate.go`, which performs a DNS lookup and rejects reserved IP addresses during webhook registration.

A second protection layer exists at runtime. `safeDialContext` in `internal/webhook/webhook.go` intercepts TCP dials and blocks reserved IPs via `isReservedIP` from `validate.go`. This prevents DNS rebinding attacks. The `AllowPrivateIPs` flag in `cmd/memos/main.go` can bypass this check.

## Findings

### Where HTTP actually runs

Outbound delivery is **not** in the API handlers. Content-change handlers only enqueue work:

| Layer | Path | Role |
|---|---|---|
| Trigger | `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go` | `dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook` / comment variant build payloads and call `webhook.PostAsync` |
| Side effects | `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_update_helpers.go` | `dispatchMemoUpdatedSideEffects` → `DispatchMemoUpdatedWebhook` |
| Queue | `/bench/repo/internal/webhook/webhook.go` | `PostAsync` pushes to `asyncPostQueue`; 4 `init()` goroutines drain it |
| **HTTP execution** | `/bench/repo/internal/webhook/webhook.go` | **`Post`** — builds `http.NewRequest`, then **`safeClient.Do(req)`** (line 152) |

**Delivery function:** `Post` — `/bench/repo/internal/webhook/webhook.go`

---

### What blocks internal/reserved addresses (SSRF)

Two layers, both in `internal/webhook`:

| Layer | Path | Function | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| Registration guard | `/bench/repo/internal/webhook/validate.go` | **`ValidateURL`** (+ **`isReservedIP`**) | Create/update webhook URL in `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/user_service_webhooks.go` |
| Runtime guard | `/bench/repo/internal/webhook/webhook.go` | **`safeDialContext`** (+ **`isReservedIP`**) | Every outbound dial via `safeClient`’s custom `Transport.DialContext` |

**Protection core:** `isReservedIP` in `/bench/repo/internal/webhook/validate.go` — rejects loopback, RFC-1918, link-local (incl. `169.254.0.0/16`), and IPv6 ULA/link-local via `reservedCIDRs`.

`safeDialContext` re-resolves the host at dial time so DNS rebinding cannot bypass the registration-time check.

**Bypass:** `AllowPrivateIPs` (same package, set from `--allow-private-webhooks` in `/bench/repo/cmd/memos/main.go`) disables both checks for self-hosted use.
